reason: The hypothesis combines the beneficial effect of fine intermetallics on passivation (P4, P5) with the detrimental effect of coarsened intermetallic networks on corrosion (P5) into a single time-dependent two-stage model for a Mg-containing lightweight HEA, and links this to oxidation resistance (P18, P44) through a mechanism of precipitate-coarsening disrupting the oxide film, which is not stated in any single passage. It also applies the kinetic phase evolution concepts (P8, P9, P13, P19, P22, P15, P16, P26, P25, P32, P33, P40, P43, P27, P24, P31) to a new alloy system and integrates corrosion and oxidation behaviors that are treated separately in the literature.
